ng-add.description: Scaffold selected environments or apply an explicitly reviewed environment plan.

inspect.description: Inspect one Angular application and emit a read-only environment plan.

propose.description: Create a mutation proposal from explicitly selected environment sources and targets.

apply.description: Apply an explicitly reviewed mutation plan to the selected consumer workspace.

validate-plan.description: Validate a reviewed environment plan without applying it.

environment-model.description: Propose or explicitly apply a reviewed self-contained environment model.
